title: Practice: audit a support agent's sessions and name the first fix (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 a mixed set of sessions gets every rate and the first fix
cases.says: A mixed set of six sessions gets every field right and the first fix

cases.id: e1 no sessions give zero rates and no diagnosis
cases.says: No sessions: zero everywhere, a rate of 0, no diagnosis

cases.id: e2 a protected call before a successful identity check is a skipped prerequisite
cases.says: The prerequisite is the order of the steps, and a failed identity check does not open the gate

cases.id: e3 a refund over the limit counts only when it was made
cases.says: Only a refund that was made counts as over the limit

cases.id: e4 money first then tool descriptions then escalation criteria
cases.says: The order of fixes: code, then descriptions (a tie goes to descriptions), then criteria

cases.id: e5 the target boundary and rounding of the first contact rate
cases.says: The rate at exactly 0.8 meets the target, 0.6 does not, 2 of 3 is 0.667, and over- and under-escalation are counted apart

cases.id: e6 a wrong tool counts sessions and ignores steps with no known right tool
cases.says: The wrong tool counts sessions and ignores steps whose right tool is not known
